newsitem.title: USA: ADT case against Chase delayed.
newsitem.headline: ADT case against Chase delayed.

text.p: Oral arguments on a motion to temporarily halt Chase Manhattan Corp's work for client Western Resources Inc was put off for several days after a brief session on Monday before Judge Herman Cahn of the New York State Supreme Court.

Cahn informed lawyers that his son, Milton, is a tax lawyer for Chase Manhttan. Lawyers for both Chase and the plaintiff, ADT Operations Inc, a unit of ADT Ltd, said they did not object to having Cahn hear the case despite his son's affiliation.
ADT is seeking $50 millioin in punitive damages in the case, in which it alleges that Chase Manhattan, a lender tor ADT, breached fiduciary duty in its backing of the Western bid.

During a conference at the bench, an attorney for ADT said three Chase employees who had been advising management of ADT did not even know of Chase's work for Western Resources until a public announcement.in December.
Cahn said he had not read all the papers in the case and would contact lawyers in a few days.
